causebase_summary: Australian Conservation Foundation Incorporated is an environmental advocacy organisation registered in Victoria that campaigns nationally across Australia. It runs public campaigns on climate, nature and land-use issues using petitions, open letters and submissions to federal decision-makers. The organisation raises funds to support legal action in environmental cases, organises public programs such as bushwalks and a children’s wildlife art competition, and recruits and supports local volunteer groups. It also promotes targeted corporate and government actions (for example on deforestation and fossil-fuel projects) and solicits signatures for parliamentary and ministerial submissions.

data.SummaryOfActivities: ACF is Australia s national environment organisation. We are more than half a million people who speak out for the air we breathe, the water we drink and the places and wildlife we love. We see a world where nature and people thrive and we empower people to stand up for nature. We disrupt business-as-usual that harms nature, create solutions for nature and people and activate people to stand up for nature. We push for bold solutions, and use evidence-based advocacy, courage, creativity and common sense to expose corruption and destruction and create real solutions for a better future. We won t give up until Australia s nature is protected and regenerated. Nature needs us, now!
